'''Corran Antillies Court of the vile mandolarian (and battle droids)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Corran Antillies]]
* '''Published:''' 3 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Vile Antillies DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is an update of my court deck.  I use lots of bounty hunters, and threw in a few battle droids for defense against jedi and WYS.

== Strategy ==

ok, I pull all my docking bays with the objective.  I use all my bounty hunters to capture stuff.  I have resistance in there, because I'm deathly afraid that someone will camp out at a site with five hundred characters and do some kind of force drain that kills me.  I'm going to try to fit in some virtual cards, like Greedo, Ket malis, and Oota goota solo, so don't hold that too much against me. (I don't have enough of the little sleeves yet, but I'll be getting them soon.)  I have a JPSD on the way, so I'll have three more effects to work with and a persona of jabba.  The Battle droids in there are for defense.  Two signifagantly damage Jedi, and one destroys smugglers.  I'm putting together a WYS deck too (See "I know I need to watch my step with this deck", so this deck needed some kind of defense against that.  The only other thing I can think of is scum, I don't have that one yet, but I'm going to get it in a trade if it doesn't show up in my jpsd.  Please take this into consideration when you rate me.
